region.description: Sales region from the governed country mapping. Europe is the EU countries, the United Kingdom and Switzerland.

product_family.description: Product family of the invoiced product.

quarter.description: Calendar quarter. The lab holds the last four complete quarters.

supplier.description: Supplier by golden key, shown with its name.

net_revenue.label: Net revenue
net_revenue.description: Gross invoiced amount less credit notes for returns, less rebate accruals.
net_revenue.base: SELECT i.quarter, d.region, i.product_family, i.gross - COALESCE(c.returns, 0) - COALESCE(r.rebates, 0) AS amount FROM (SELECT quarter, country, product_family, SUM(gross_amount) AS gross FROM invoices GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) i LEFT JOIN (SELECT v.quarter, v.country, v.product_family, SUM(n.amount) AS returns FROM credit_notes n JOIN invoices v USING (invoice_id) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) c USING (quarter, country, product_family) LEFT JOIN (SELECT quarter, country, product_family, SUM(amount) AS rebates FROM rebate_accruals GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) r USING (quarter, country, product_family) JOIN dim_country d USING (country)

gross_revenue.label: Gross revenue
gross_revenue.description: Invoiced amount before returns and rebates.
gross_revenue.base: SELECT i.quarter, d.region, i.product_family, i.gross_amount AS amount FROM invoices i JOIN dim_country d USING (country)

procurement_spend.label: Procurement spend
procurement_spend.description: Value of purchase orders placed with suppliers.
procurement_spend.base: SELECT p.quarter, p.supplier_key || ' ' || s.supplier_name AS supplier, p.amount FROM purchase_orders p JOIN dim_supplier s USING (supplier_key)

procurement_spend_share.label: Share of procurement spend
procurement_spend_share.description: A supplier's procurement spend as a percentage of all procurement spend in the same quarters.
procurement_spend_share.base: SELECT p.quarter, p.supplier_key || ' ' || s.supplier_name AS supplier, p.amount FROM purchase_orders p JOIN dim_supplier s USING (supplier_key)
procurement_spend_share.expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM purchase_orders WHERE {quarter_filter}), 1)

otif_rate.label: On-time-in-full delivery rate
otif_rate.description: Deliveries received on time and in full, as a percentage of all deliveries.
otif_rate.base: SELECT e.quarter, e.supplier_key || ' ' || s.supplier_name AS supplier, e.on_time_in_full FROM deliveries e JOIN dim_supplier s USING (supplier_key)
